description: Schema for observability/failures/*.json — records agent failures for post-mortem analysis (L11 Harness Engineering)

field_types.failure_id: string — unique id for the failure event
field_types.skill: string — skill that was active when failure occurred
field_types.phase: string — one of: init, plan, execute, verify, handoff
field_types.error_type: string — one of: assertion, timeout, permission, contract_violation, scope_overreach, under_finish
field_types.error_message: string — exact CLI error output or description
field_types.recovery_action: string — what was done to recover (e.g. 'reverted via git checkout', 'resumed from RECOVERY_POINTS.md')

optional_fields.prevention: string — what harness change prevents recurrence

changelog.change: Initial schema — failure observability as harness primitive
